author_pitch: I have seen SMEs lose million-dollar contracts by failing a compliance audit. My mission is to build AI agents that monitor your regulations 24/7 so you only have to worry about scaling.
title: AI Agent for B2B Compliance: Pass ISO Audits on Autopilot
body:
Are you losing weeks gathering evidence for your ISO audits?

Regulatory compliance is the great bottleneck for B2B SMEs. Every year, your technical team halts production for weeks searching for documents, access logs, and screenshots across dozens of different platforms to satisfy the auditor. This waste of time not only frustrates your employees but also costs you thousands of dollars in non-billable hours and jeopardizes the renewal of your key certifications.

The trap of manual compliance

Assigning ISO evidence gathering to your engineers or managers is a critical mistake that paralyzes your company's growth. Spreadsheets and calendar reminders always end up forgotten amidst day-to-day emergencies. Compliance is not delegated to human memory, it is automated with data engineering.

Our solution: Regulatory Evidence AI Agent

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we design and integrate a private AI Agent that connects to your infrastructure, CRMs, and repositories via APIs to track and archive compliance evidence in real time, without human intervention.

  1. Continuous 24/7 gathering: The AI Agent extracts security logs, code approvals, and training records daily, archiving them in a central immutable repository.
  2. Automatic standard mapping: Artificial intelligence classifies each piece of evidence and automatically associates it with the corresponding clause of ISO 27001, ISO 9001, or GDPR.
  3. Early breach detection: If an employee forgets to sign an NDA or a server misses a security patch, the bot sends an immediate alert to your Slack or Teams channel.
  4. Auditor report generation: Export a complete and structured dossier with a single click, ready to be reviewed and approved by the certifying body.

The Real Impact on your B2B Company

  • Massive hour savings: Eliminate the pre-audit month of panic and return hundreds of technical hours to the development of your product or service.
  • Zero human errors: Guarantee that no evidence is left behind due to oversight or staff turnover, ensuring the renewal of your quality and security certificates.
  • Enterprise contract closing: Demonstrate flawless and instantaneous regulatory compliance to win bids and work with demanding large corporations.
